A person in dark clothing is seen in a partial frame, arched over a set of six red lipsticks arranged in a row in clear cases. In the background, a young man with dark hair, wearing a black jacket, is peeking from behind a white wall, laughing heartily and pointing at the person on the floor. The lighting is bright and indoor, casting soft shadows on the hallway floor. (2) The scene cuts to a similar low-angle setup in the same hallway. A man in a blue tank top and purple shorts is holding a stiff plank position. His chest and torso are supported by a row of four different pairs of Nike sneakers stacked vertically. He looks towards the camera with a focused, strained expression. Behind him stands a woman in black sportswear, her hands on her hips, looking down at him. The background is a clean indoor hallway with white walls and a green exercise mat visible on the side.
